r0.why: 3D binary operation, vector product [1],[17]; perpendicular to both, normal to plane [2]; not the dot product [4].

r1.why: Applications [3]; magnitude = parallelogram area, perpendicular case [5]; formula [45]; theta is angle [20].

r2.why: Direction depends on orientation, right-hand rule [19],[21]-[23]; reversed fingers flip sign [25]; anticommutative [24].

r3.why: Parallel/anti-parallel or zero length gives zero [7],[20]; i x i = 0 from anticommutativity [37].

r4.why: Gibbs and Heaviside 1881 notation [30]; Clifford 1877 names and reason [31]; still widely used [32].

r5.why: Depends on orientation [10], pseudovector [12],[26]; generalizations [14]; binary only in 3 and 7 dims [15].
